mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate compresses real corporate profit margins and increases the risk premium demanded by investors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 35% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) indicates a deepening economic slowdown that triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 45% of instances when both UNRATE > 8.0% and INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% for 3 consecutive months), the increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances during monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) signals strong consumer confidence and housing market strength, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 45% of instances when RSAFS rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 94.0, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate revenue growth prospects, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 35% of instances when INDPRO < 94.0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a weakening in the broader economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST < 620.0 and RSAFS < 385000.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 45% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%.
